summary:
## Review
- **Blocker (Important): V2 `BuildResult` still does not reach the durable Run contract.** `execute_dataset_build` constructs and returns `result` only in its tool JSON at [dataset_build_tool.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/pipeline/dataset_build_tool.py:241) and [dataset_build_tool.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/pipeline/dataset_build_tool.py:286). It neither installs a pending publication nor calls any Run-level `set_build_result`. Finalization therefore sees no pending publication at [runner.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/agent_loop/runner.py:1271), then the manager emits its fallback `NO_DATA` summary at [manager.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/runtime/manager.py:1829). A successful V2 publication, or B5's structured V2 NO_DATA, can consequently be reported to the frontend as the manager's generic NO_DATA and remains outside the task artifact/publication event path. B9 closes only the V1 tool envelope at [tool.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/pipeline/tool.py:619); it does not close B5 end to end.
- **Important: B5 can falsely classify a partially usable multi-source build as `NO_DATA`.** Any failed operation whose error contains `contains no data rows` makes `_is_no_data_outcome` return true unconditionally at [dataset_build_tool.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/pipeline/dataset_build_tool.py:320). Parsing is per binding at [expression_runner.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/datasets/build/expression_runner.py:135), so one header-only binding aborts the executor even when another binding contains valid rows; the returned result then marks every binding rejected at [dataset_build_tool.py](/mnt/d/code-linux/BioMed-QAgent/backend/app/pipeline/dataset_build_tool.py:241). The new test covers only a single empty source, not this mixed-source case.
